title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode6 What A Reunion Leads To

meta.Episode: Episode6 — What A Reunion Leads To
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: TV Station - Studio

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, are you here to see another shoot...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
I'm here today for a music program.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow!
You must really love TV considering how often you're here!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, I do...
As a result, I've become familiar with quite a few celebrities.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...
Is that how you knew my name?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, I've seen you on TV.
You're Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
You really know who we are? But we haven't been on TV all that much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much! I'm so happy!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm happy about getting to meet such a cute idol again...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
But are you okay?
You seemed to have your shoulders hunched just now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm okay!
Honest!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm as cheerful as ever!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: You are...?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Working in show business isn't easy.
At times, you're forced to endure quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Idols in particular, since it's your job to spread hope to others. You have to keep smiling no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I overheard a bit of what those people in the audience were saying just now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: So, if you think it'll help, would you mind telling me what you're really feeling?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What I'm really feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, if you'll give me a minute to explain...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: That explains why you seemed so deflated...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes...
We thought we were doing our best to make things as enjoyable as possible for the audience...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we ended up disappointing everyone who came here to see LiLia because we couldn't fill their shoes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I felt so powerless when I realized that...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Was there anything you could've done about that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
LiLia has its own unique qualities...
Qualities that no one else can copy.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Any group replacing them was doomed to suffer this fate. MORE MORE JUMP! just happened to draw the short straw in this case...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: So, Minori, I don't think you should be blaming yourself.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
This is actually a common occurrence.
And I've seen quite a few of these shows.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I understand what you're saying...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We can't just let things go on like this and have them leave feeling disappointed...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We should do everything we can to make sure they go home smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know what I need to do now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, you're right about us having no hope of filling LiLia's shoes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we still need to do everything in our power to ensure that our audience has even a little bit of fun or gets even a little bit of energy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That should allow them to keep believing in a better tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm going to try even harder during the remainder of this shoot...!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Talking with you has really helped clear up my mind for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for listening!
I feel so much better now!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad I could repay the favor you did for me the other day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, please don't worry about that!
It was nothing. Really...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, our break's almost over!
I've gotta head back to the set!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry for not noticing sooner!
I need to return for my shoot and...!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. You should hurry.
And good luck with the rest of your shoot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I hope we see each other again...!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Me too...
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can I get a camera over here?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You gotta show Mr. Arimura's daifuku!
It's overflowing with red bean paste! Look!

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
Haha. Talk about a close-up!
But this does make it easier for the audience to see.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Yes, on top of seeing that it's coarse and not fine, they're getting a look at how wrinkly my hands are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ever since our break ended, Minori's been making a huge effort to please the audience.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And they seem much more interested in what's going on compared to earlier.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I dunno what happened during the break, but this is going great...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That means we gotta follow her lead.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm loving your segment about local delicacies hiding in plain sight, MYU! I feel like I'm going somewhere else with every bite I take!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me too...
I knew you traveled a lot as an influencer, but I didn't realize just how knowledgeable you are about local delicacies.

rows.Speaker: MYU
rows.Line:
That's definitely one way to get on my good side!
I've still got plenty more in store. Next, we have...

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me! Sorry!
We need to stop temporarily!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line:
Now?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...!
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: We're missing a lot of footage...

rows.Speaker: Kuromiya
rows.Line:
How much?
From where...?

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line:
W-We're missing...
Everything since the break...

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They didn't get any of that forty-minute conversation we just had...?!
